plan: Since my value for the item is $26, I should bid close to it to maximize potential profit. Bidding my exact value or slightly below ensures I win if others undervalue it, while minimizing loss if I overestimate their bids. Dominated bids are those above $26, as they guarantee a loss if I win. I'll bid $25.9 to avoid ties and potentially win if others bid slightly lower.

My private value is $35, which is above the maximum possible value of $20. This means I can bid aggressively. To maximize profit, I should bid slightly above $20 to outbid any competitors, ensuring I win and pay the second-highest bid. Bidding $20.1 is optimal as it minimizes payment while guaranteeing a win, assuming others bid based on their maximum possible value.

Given my value of $17, I should aim to bid just below my value to maximize profit. Bidding exactly $17 could lead to a break-even situation if the second-highest bid matches mine. To avoid dominated strategies, bidding above $17 is unwise since it could lead to a loss. I will bid slightly above the midpoint of $0 and $17 to outbid competitors but stay profitable. A bid of $15.5 balances the risk of overbidding and the chance of winning, assuming others bid randomly between $0 and $20.
